newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher as Dow rebounds.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher as Dow rebounds.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index opened firmer on Wednesday, encouraged by a strong finish on Wall Street overnight but with gains seen capped ahead of U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony to Congress. The FTSE was up 9.7 points at 4,354.4 points by 0845 GMT, within reach of the all-time high of 4,362.4. Gainers were in a two-to-one majority.

"We will probably try and visit the closing and all-time highs today," said one trader. The initial advance came on the back of a recovery on Wall Street where the Dow closed 30 points higher after being down 20 points as London markets closed.
